title: WPCRL/1487/2013 of Surendra Kamboj @ Chinda Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT
NAINITAL
Criminal Writ Petition No. 1487 of 2013
Surendra Kamboj @ Chinda ........... Petitioner

versus
State of Uttarakhand and others .......... Respondents

Mr. B.S.Parihar, Advocate, present for the petitioner.
Mr. H.O.Bhakuni, learned AGA, present for the State/respondents no. 1 & 2.
Mr. Mohd. Azim, Advocate, present for the respondent no.3.
U.C. Dhyani, J. (Oral)
1. A complaint was given to Divisional Forest Officer of
Tarai West, Ram Nagar Tarai Division, Nainital by the
respondent no. 3 against the writ petitioner
2. The said complaint was given with the request that the
contract given to the petitioner be cancelled. The reason
behind such cancellation of contract was assigned to the
faulty weighing machine (dharm kanta) of the petitioner.
3. Now, the respondent no. 3, who is present in person before
the Court, duly identified by his counsel Mr. Mohd. Azim,
says that he is not willing to prosecute the petitioner. He is
not interested in pursuing his prayer.

2
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that criminal
writ petition of the petitioner should be allowed, to which
learned counsel for the respondent no. 3 has no objection.
5. In view of such development, Criminal Writ Petition is
allowed. Complaint dated 12.12.2013 filed against the
petitioner Surendra Kamboj @ Chinda registered as FIR
No. 305 of 2013, under Sections 420 of IPC and 26 of the
Forest Act, are hereby quashed.
 (U.C. Dhyani, J.)
 14.03.2014
Kaushal
